Admin routes of the license module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/license

License status, claims and grace window

Parameters:

- `fresh` in query (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: License verdict.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## POST /v1/admin/license/install

Install a signed license file, verified before it is written

Responses:

- `200`: The verdict of the newly installed license.
- `400`: The file did not verify, and nothing was written.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
